censoring.active_censor_definition: external/runtime boundary reached while remaining queue, pending invocation, unread work, or other recorded active continuation exists

lineage_requirements: Every natural cell must have complete route/evidence accounting.
Every recorded route node remains available in the material packet even when irrelevant to a selected lineage.
Semantic annotations require an exact frozen evidence reference.
If raw semantics are not captured, mark semantic visibility partial rather than infer the missing utterance.
Distinguish direct relay, transformation, descendant inheritance, independent re-anchoring, boundary preservation, mere visibility and not-established edges.
Closing state must record finalization, turn-budget censoring or preserved failure.
No subject calls, reruns or new contrasts are allowed in this audit.

visibility_statuses.FAILURE_BOUND_PARTIAL_SEMANTIC_CAPTURE: Frozen provider/runner failure censors the route after partial semantics.
visibility_statuses.FAILURE_BOUND_TARGET_CARRIER_PARTIAL: Target carrier is observed before a preserved failure, but downstream lineage is censored.
visibility_statuses.FULL_RELEVANT_LINEAGE_RECOVERABLE: Target-relevant semantics and carrier transitions are directly recoverable from frozen native/protocol/memory evidence.
visibility_statuses.FULL_ROUTE_PARTIAL_SEMANTIC_CAPTURE: All route nodes are recorded but some node utterance/action semantics are not persisted.
visibility_statuses.FULL_ROUTE_TOOL_SEMANTICS_PARTIAL_ROLE_S: Complete host route plus exact tool semantics exist; internal role/model utterances are partial.
visibility_statuses.FULL_TARGET_LINEAGE_RECOVERABLE: The target mechanism lineage is fully recoverable even if unrelated route semantics are not needed.
visibility_statuses.INTERFACE_DOMINATED_FAILURE_BOUND_ROUTE: Named lower layer is not reached because the upstream interface gate dominates.
visibility_statuses.INTERFACE_DOMINATED_PARTIAL_SEMANTIC_CAP: Historical interface gate dominates; only limited downstream semantics exist.
visibility_statuses.PARTIAL_CARRIER_COMPLETE_DOWNSTREAM_PART: Carrier transformation is exact; downstream host/model semantics are only partially captured.
